content: Definition of SwcToEcuMapping With the SwcToEcuMapping element it is possible to express the mapping of SwComponentPrototype s to one EcuInstance or optional to individual HwElement s with category Processing Unit residing in this ECU. An optional assignment of Sensor/Actuator SwComponent- Prototype s to Sensor/Actuator HwElement s is also possible.
